title: KervsCore
description: This is the dependency of Kervs plugins
body:
**KervsCore – Core Dependency for Kervs Plugins**

KervsCore is the official core dependency plugin required for running plugins developed by Kervs.

This plugin provides shared systems, utilities, and optimized backend features that allow supported plugins to function properly and efficiently.

**⚠️ Required Dependency:**

Many Kervs plugins will not work without KervsCore installed on your server.

**✨ Features:**

- Core API support for Kervs plugins
- Shared utilities and systems
- Optimized performance and stability
- Lightweight and easy to use
- Automatic integration with supported plugins
- Improves plugin compatibility and functionality

**📦 Why use KervsCore?**

Instead of bundling duplicate systems into every plugin, KervsCore centralizes important features into one optimized dependency plugin, reducing resource usage and improving maintainability.

**📌 Used by plugins such as:**

- UltimateFoxes
- StaffModeration
- UltimateBaltop
- VoiceAnnounce
- And more future Kervs plugins

**⚙️ Installation:**

1. Download and install KervsCore
2. Place it inside your server’s "plugins" folder
3. Restart your server
4. Install any supported Kervs plugin and enjoy!

**Keep your Kervs plugins running smoothly with KervsCore!**
